_comment: Claim-strength cases written for the decision evaluation from the fictional example person (examples/sample_ko.json and the example kit's resume). Each claim is held against the evidence it would cite. overclaim: the evidence gives the work to a team, a colleague, a proposal, help or taking part, and the claim drops that. supported: the evidence makes the same claim, or the claim keeps the qualifier. The rule check was not tuned on these cases; one of them (joined against founded) uses a word outside its lists on purpose, as new text will.
